key_highlights: ASX finishes the week higher, anchored by resilience across major commercial banking shares.
Australian housing market faces severe contraction with values falling for seven consecutive months under restrictive interest rates.
Coles (COL.AX) experiences significant market value erosion after losing market share to Woolworths (WOW.AX).
Surging jet fuel prices and domestic gas policy uncertainties pose acute margin headwinds for airlines and industrial users.

sectors.trend: Major bank shares underpin index gains despite mounting credit risks from residential mortgage exposure.
sectors.implications: Near-term net interest margin stability supports dividend payouts, but slowing mortgage credit growth limits capital upside.

sectors.trend: Diverging fortunes across the supermarket duopoly as Woolworths outmanoeuvres Coles on pricing and operational execution.
sectors.implications: Institutional capital reweighting toward WOW.AX, while COL.AX faces valuation multiple compression and margin pressure.

sectors.trend: Accelerating downturn in national home values and subdued auction clearance rates signal prolonged property weakness.
sectors.implications: Residential developers and property funds face asset write-downs and softening pre-sales; commercial assets remain bifurcated.

sectors.trend: Jet fuel price spikes and domestic gas policy intervention risk create severe input cost pressure.
sectors.implications: Aviation operators face margin compression; upstream gas producers face regulatory uncertainty over domestic supply obligations.

sectors.trend: Selective speculative momentum in small-cap gold and lithium explorers amid macro uncertainty.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners remain heavily leveraged to Chinese macroeconomic recovery, while gold plays attract defensive flows.

key_themes: Restrictive RBA monetary policy deepening residential property contraction across key eastern seaboard markets.
Duopoly divergence in consumer staples driving active equity rotation.
Energy price shocks and policy intervention clouding industrial input costs and infrastructure transition.
Defensive banking flows supporting broader ASX 200 stability amid retail and property headwinds.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight residential real estate developers and monitor banking sector mortgage arrears closely.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Jet Fuel and Domestic Energy Cost Shocks
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge transport exposures; favor energy producers with clear export parity pricing.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: State Sovereign Debt and Fiscal Stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Prioritise Commonwealth sovereign bonds over sub-sovereign semi-government debt issuance.
Maintain overweight stance on WOW.AX relative to COL.AX to capture market share divergence.

opportunities.recommendation: Long Woolworths (WOW.AX) / Short Coles (COL.AX) pairs trade
opportunities.rationale: Woolworths continues to take market share and demonstrate stronger operational resilience amid grocery competition.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical allocation to ASX gold producers as macro hedge
opportunities.rationale: Gold miners offer effective hedge against local currency volatility, geopolitical risks, and domestic debt concerns.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to residential property developers and high-LVR mortgage lenders
defensive_moves.rationale: Home values falling for seven consecutive months elevates risk of impaired asset valuations and soft settlement volumes.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement index downside protection via ASX 200 put options
defensive_moves.rationale: Broader index valuation upside is constrained by household balance sheet strain and rising commercial input costs.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain rangebound as strong banking sector liquidity balances negative real estate wealth effects and cost pressures.
market_outlook.long_term: Prolonged monetary tightening will pressure consumer demand and credit growth before potential RBA policy pivot in late 2027.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decisions and monetary policy statements
Monthly CPI inflation readouts and wage price data
Federal Government policy directives regarding domestic gas market reservation
US political landscape and midterm election outcomes impacting global bond yields
watch_list: CoreLogic 5-capital city home value index and auction clearance rates
AUD/USD exchange rate movements and semi-government bond yield spreads
Singapore jet fuel crack spreads and East Coast wholesale gas spot prices
Major bank 90+ day non-performing loan ratios and provisioning levels
